subject: Post-demo: confirm token profile, budget owner & sign-off path
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@sagedx.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@sagedx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: confirm token profile, budget owner & sign-off path

Hi Elaine / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciated the thoughtful questions about latency targets and data isolation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move toward a scoped proposal: 

- Estimated steady-state token volume: you mentioned ~45M tokens/month across the clinical-notes pipeline and 20M tokens/month for the triage assistant. Can you confirm those numbers (or a range)?
- Target unit economics: you indicated a target of ~$850–1,100 per 1M tokens for the combined workload. Is that the budgeted range we should price to?
- Contract & sign-off flow: who at Sage owns the budget (cost center/account owner) vs. who will sign the SOW? We need the finance approver + legal contact for procurement timing.

Next steps I propose: I’ll send a one-page estimate with a couple of pricing bands (baseline quantized model vs. latency-optimized variant) and a recommended canary rollout schedule. If you can confirm volumes and the budget owner this week, I can get the estimate to you by Wed.

Attaching a short pricing primer and demo screenshots.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf (one-pager), demo-screenshots.zip (images)

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192


From: Elaine Park <elaine@sagedx.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@sagedx.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: confirm token profile, budget owner & sign-off path

Monica — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround on materials. 

Confirmed numbers (best estimate right now):
- Clinical notes pipeline: 40–50M tokens/month (likely 45M steady-state)
- Triage assistant (low-latency chat): 15–25M tokens/month (expect 20M)
- Spurts during product launches could add ~10–15% for 2–3 days/month

Budgeting / approval:
- Budget owner: Tom Reed (VP Product Operations) — tom.reed@sagedx.com
- Finance approver: Ilya Morgan (Director of Finance) — ilya.morgan@sagedx.com (Ilya requests a one-page unit-econ summary + expected monthly spend)
- Legal / procurement contact: Sara Lin (procurement@sagedx.com)

Target unit economics: the $850–1,100/1M tokens is the internal target band. Critical constraint for us is predictable monthly spend against a committed cap; we prefer a pricing path that allows a capped committed amount with burst capacity.

Can you include a worked example showing expected monthly bill at 45M + 20M tokens for both pricing bands? Also show impact of a 10% burst.

If you can CC Ilya on the estimate we can speed approval.

Thanks,
Elaine
Head of Integrations | Sage Diagnostics
elaine@sagedx.com

Hi Ilya / Sara / Tom — looping you in per Elaine’s note. Quick context: Sage Diagnostics is evaluating Redwood for a mixed workload (clinical notes + low-latency triage chat). Estimated baseline ~65M tokens/month combined with occasional bursts. Elaine requested a concise unit-econ summary and an example monthly spend for two pricing bands we discussed (quantized baseline vs latency-optimized).

Vivek — can you own a 1-page unit-econ that shows:
- Cost per 1M tokens for the two bands (list both list price and a committed-commit option)
- Example monthly spend rows: 45M + 20M = 65M, plus a +10% burst scenario
- A brief note on caching assumptions (we’ll assume 12% prefix caching on clinical notes)

Laura — can you confirm standard sign-off flow for a $XX–$YYK/mo committed arrangement and whether we can offer a capped-commit with burst? Sage is explicitly asking for a commit + burst model.

Ilya / Sara — if we can get the approver info (Ilya) and procurement contact (Sara) on timing that would be helpful. I’ve attached the one-pager estimate and screenshots.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Monica / team,

Quick answers from legal/contracting & pricing side:
- Standard sign-off: (1) technical pilot PO from customer finance OR signed SOW for committed term; (2) procurement review; (3) PO or countersigned SOW. For this size (~$XX–$YYK/mo) we usually require a 6–12 month commit to qualify for capped-burst rates.
- We can structure a capped-commit with a burst uplift (e.g., base price for committed usage, 1.5x price for any usage above cap during burst days). Exact numbers depend on model variant and quantization.
- Vivek, please attach the two-band unit-econ here when you have it and I’ll draft the commercial note and required SOW language.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
